visual_loops.rationale: Compact 20–23s delivery for mobile retention while preserving complete authored temporal cycles and exact visual/audio endpoint alignment.

visual_drills.note: Current C11-C contract: 3s PRE_ROLL + family gameplay + 3s END_CTA. Tracking uses 21s gameplay / 27s total; Saccade, Pursuit and Peripheral Scan use 17s gameplay / 23s total.

longform_visual_loops.description: Long-form family anthology remains 180s overall. Internal chapters use the revised 20..23s Visual Loop duration policy.
